parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the application group. You can find this ID on the **Application Management** page in the console.

parameters.name: InstanceParameters
parameters.description: The dynamic parameters for the workflow instance. The value cannot exceed 1,000 bytes.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The ID of the namespace. You can find this ID on the **Namespace** page in the console.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: This parameter is required only for specific third-party integrations.
